purpose: Exact bounded G0.4 common-input proof contract. It is not a shipping-runtime selection, public-distribution approval, import implementation, persistence change, performance guarantee, or customer hardware minimum.
scopeBoundaries: Guaranteed-common is limited to the explicit guaranteedCases array; fields describe an individual case and do not authorize a range or cross-product beyond that array.
Component presence is prerequisite evidence only; each case requires explicit inspect, stream selection, strict complete decode, and declared oracle execution.
Fixture producers are proof infrastructure only and are never a shipping dependency, portable project requirement, or decoder proof.

fixtureRecipeRules: Every non-Matroska guaranteed case references one immutable recipe whose source primitives, producer encoders, muxer, filters, extension, and oracle profile are all declared.
A recipe marked unresolved-producer is an honest blocked fixture-provenance result; no fallback producer, system image library, or unapproved component may be substituted.
Matroska cases reference the single stream-copy-only recipe and their sourceCaseId; they inherit no generalized container compatibility.
